title: Regulatory network architecture constrains inflammatory responses in tissue-resident alveolar macrophages.
authors: Kruszelnicki, Sonia M; Chakraborty, Sreeparna; Wang, Xinge; Rehman, Jalees; Singh, Harinder; Gottschalk, Rachel A
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文整合单细胞RNA-seq、ATAC-seq和深度学习染色质可及性建模推断巨噬细胞基因调控网络，涉及PU.1等转录因子与DNA调控，但非直接TF-DNA结合建模，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Macrophages across different tissues exhibit remarkable functional diversity while maintaining core innate immune-cell programming. These complex programs are governed by gene regulatory networks, in which precise transcription factor activity tunes the expression of functionally relevant gene modules. Although the contributions of individual transcription factors have been well characterized, the higher-order regulatory interactions that coordinate tissue-resident macrophage identity and inflammatory response regulation remain poorly understood. Here, we integrate single-cell RNA-seq data with ATAC-seq profiling and deep-learning-based chromatin accessibility modeling to infer gene regulatory network architectures in tissue-resident versus recruited monocyte-derived alveolar macrophages under inflammatory stress. Our results suggest that inflammatory responses are more restrained in tissue-resident alveolar macrophages compared with recruited macrophages due to a stabilizing regulatory network architecture involving PU.1 and CEBP/beta. This work advances our understanding of functional plasticity in tissue-resident macrophages and their role in host defense.
abstract_zh: 不同组织中的巨噬细胞在维持核心固有免疫细胞编程的同时，展现出显著的功能多样性。这些复杂程序由基因调控网络（gene regulatory networks）控制，其中精确的转录因子活性调节着功能相关基因模块的表达。尽管单个转录因子的贡献已被充分表征，但协调组织驻留巨噬细胞身份和炎症反应调控的高阶调控相互作用仍知之甚少。在此，我们整合单细胞RNA-seq数据、ATAC-seq谱图以及基于深度学习的染色质可及性建模，以推断炎症应激下组织驻留巨噬细胞与招募的单核细胞来源肺泡巨噬细胞中的基因调控网络架构。我们的结果表明，与招募的巨噬细胞相比，组织驻留肺泡巨噬细胞的炎症反应受到更多限制，这归因于涉及PU.1和CEBP/beta的稳定调控网络架构。这项工作推进了我们对组织驻留巨噬细胞功能可塑性及其在宿主防御中作用的理解。
